WALANG PASOK: Class suspensions for Monday, October 20, 2025
Classes for Monday, October 20, 2025 have been suspended in some areas due to the effects of Tropical Storm Ramil.
Region I Ilocos Region
ADVERTISEMENT
Pangasinan:
Aguilar - no face-to-face classes, all levels, public and private; shift to alternative learning modules
Alaminos - no classes, all levels
Basista - no classes, daycare to senior high school
Bayambang - no face-to-face classes, all levels, public and private; shift to alternative learning modules
Binmaley - no classes, all levels, public and private
Calasiao - no classes, kinder to senior high school, public and private
San Carlos - no face-to-face classes, all levels, public and private; shift to alternative learning modules
Sta. Barbara - no classes, all levels, public and private
Santo Tomas - no face-to-face classes, all levels, public
Urbiztondo - no face-to-face classes, all levels, public and private; shift to alternative learning modules

Pampanga:
Angeles City - no classes, all levels, public and private
Arayat - no face-to-face classes, all levels, public and private; shift to alternative learning modules

San Fernando - no face-to-face classes, all levels, public and private; shift to alternative learning modules
Quezon
Lucena City - no face-to-face classes, all levels, public and private; shift to alternative learning modules (Oct. 20-22) due to spread of flu and pneumonia

Region IV-A Calabarzon
